description: An oil-style painting of a night street clash in a square. A man in a flat cap and dark coat grips a torn red banner in the foreground, with a crowd of men in bowler hats and caps behind him. Mounted police in dark uniforms with batons and red-coated helmeted mounted soldiers charge through, under gas lamps. A black lion statue and a tall column with a relief sit behind, with a domed building on the right and smoky dark sky.
